FOR STUDENTS & FAMILIES

From the first piece to an individual voice.

I design a personal path for children, teenagers and adults—from technique, reading and rhythm to tone, style and stage presence. Each lesson balances long-term musical growth with visible progress.

ARTIST PROFILE

Professional training, always in service of music.

A graduate of École Normale de Musique de Paris, Mixiao Wang holds a Master’s in Piano Performance and an Advanced Master’s in Chamber Music Performance.

He studied with Dr. Jiale Wang, Prof. Ramzi Yassa and Prof. Gaspard Dehaene, and chamber music with Prof. Nina Patarcec.
